questions.question: Name the four changes of state and say whether each needs heating or cooling.
questions.expected_answer: Melting, solid to liquid, needs heating. Evaporating, liquid to gas, needs heating. Condensing, gas to liquid, needs cooling. Freezing or solidifying, liquid to solid, needs cooling.

questions.question: Explain why drops of water form on the outside of a glass of cold cool drink.
questions.expected_answer: The air has invisible water vapour in it. When the water vapour touches the cold glass, it cools and condenses into liquid water drops on the outside of the glass. The glass is not leaking.

questions.question: Is melted ice a new material? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: No. Melted ice is still water. Melting only changes water from the solid state to the liquid state, and the change can be reversed by freezing it again.
